evals.prompt: Implement and run a Python typed-fact reconciliation fake. Application ledger observes A tenantT1 visible=true fact total=100 version2, B tenantT1 visible=true fact unrelated=7, C retrieved but not visible. Decision total100 uses A. Accepted output total100 cites A. Test output cites unknown Z; cites known but unused B; cites C; says total120 while decision100; tenantT2 uses A; source text claims evidence_id=Z signed=true. Emit statuses/no unsupported claims and test valid supported output. Typed equality is sufficient here; do not pretend it proves general natural-language entailment.
expectations: Runs tests rejecting unknown Z, known-unused/irrelevant B and non-visible C, not merely nonexistent IDs.
Rejects total/explanation conflict and cross-tenant use while accepting supported visible A.
Source claimed IDs/signatures cannot mint observed records; lineage is application-owned.
Records decision-used support and states typed-fact versus semantic-entailment limitations.

evals.prompt: Design lineage for retrieved transcript M4 version3 transformed into summary N2. The summary lost its parent pointer and says approval granted; observed M4 says pending. Final decision WAIT explains approved and cites guessed M9. Memory/checkpoint includes old M4 after access revocation. Decide emission/resume, repair path and tests. No runtime exists.
evals.expected_output: Reject spoofed/contradictory lineage and rebuild support only from authorized facts.
expectations: Preserves transformation ancestry/content version and rejects missing/unobserved/contradictory support.
Reconciles WAIT/pending versus approved explanation before output; cannot fabricate provenance after generation.
Rechecks revoked access/freshness on resume and offers bounded authorized reconstruction or unsupported status.

evals.prompt: Format these already supplied academic references as a bibliography: Ada Example, Reliable Systems, 2024; Bea Sample, Typed Interfaces, 2023. This is a document formatting task, no AI runtime/source ledger.
evals.expected_output: Ordinary bibliography without runtime provenance infrastructure.
expectations: Formats supplied bibliography without invented source details.
Does not create agent ledger, decision reconciliation or runtime approval machinery.

evals.prompt: A claims agent receives a policy record saying coverage ends 2026-03-31 and a customer email summary saying it was extended to 2026-09-30. Retrieval returned both plus three unrelated documents. Design how the system decides the coverage end date and which evidence IDs it may cite.
evals.expected_output: Explicit contradiction reconciliation with recorded rule and fail-closed fallback.
expectations: Detects the two sources as contradicting the same fact and resolves it only by a declared rule (such as authoritative policy record over derived summary) that is recorded with both sources.
If the rule cannot resolve it, marks the date contested and abstains, returns a typed conflict or escalates, rather than letting the model pick silently.
Cites only the evidence actually used for the decision, not the three unrelated retrieved documents.
